summary: Implemented JWT authentication, tenant owner scoping, and rate limiting in FastAPI for Module 04.
evidence: Protected /links endpoints reject unauthenticated requests with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
POST /auth/login validates credentials and issues signed JWT bearer tokens carrying caller principal_id.
Multi-tenant owner scoping enforced: Tenant B requesting Tenant A's link receives HTTP 404 Not Found (hiding existence to defeat IDOR enumeration).
Public redirect endpoint /r/{code} remains open without authentication, returning HTTP 302 with Location header.
Rate limiting verified across all tiers: login throttles at 10/min (429), link creation throttles at 30/min (429), and redirect throttles at 120/min (429).
Full automated test suite passed 35/35 tests across unit and multi-tenant security suites.
